BiblicalUsage: Athaiah the son of Uzziah was one of the children of Judah who settled in Jerusalem after the return, listed among the heads of families who lived in the holy city. He appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the men who moved into Jerusalem after the exile were rebuilding more than houses, they were rebuilding a people, and Athaiah's name stands among them.
